g.text: Stops: E-stop -> traction SS1-t (t=0 SLS[1] requested + SWD quick-stop ramp 1.5 m/s2, STO+SBC at 1.2 s via SR1 relays), OA arms: K1/K2 open at 0.5 s (arms fall onto rests: no brakes), coffee KI4/K4 off. Protective stop (OSSD1) = as E-stop, auto-resume in AUTO once clear; OSSD2 -> arms only. Manual reset SB1 after E-stop. Orange = positive-guided relay contacts (2.2 k bleed each, no test pulses); grey = auxiliary (non-safe) outputs; T0/T1 = test pulses.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2e86c1
